limitations: This receipt covers only the eight retained NYC Democratic House contests; absence from the NYC result index is not an uncontested or no-primary disposition.
Crossover recaps supply whole-district totals assembled across NYC counties; CD08 in 2022 is a Kings County whole-district recap and CD12 in 2022 is a New York County whole-district recap.
Named and unattributable write-in options are retained as reported options but are not identity reviewed or progressive classified.
No result is public, evaluator-integrated, current-incumbent bound, or historical-geography approved.
